headers._comment: sw.js — MUST NEVER be CDN-cached. Browser detects a new SW
headers._comment2: only by byte-comparing the freshly downloaded sw.js against
headers._comment3: the installed copy. no-store prevents any CDN/browser caching.

headers._comment: index.html — must revalidate on every request so users
headers._comment2: always get the latest HTML (which loads the latest app.js).
headers._comment3: no-cache = revalidate with server (uses ETag/304, still fast).

headers._comment: JS files — revalidate on every request to prevent stale code.
CSS — revalidate so style changes reach users immediately.
manifest.json — revalidate so PWA metadata is always current.
offline.html — revalidate so the offline page is always current.

headers._comment2: max-age=604800 = 7 days. These change only when the icon set changes.
